titulo: 1 real por segundo: quanto tempo até o milhão? (modo caprichado)

blocos.fala: Se você ganhasse um real por segundo, quanto tempo levaria pra ficar milionário?

cena.prompt: Our character standing on a sunny city sidewalk, looking up with a surprised happy face as shiny gold coins fall from the sky like rain around him, one coin bouncing off his head. Behind him, small buildings, a lamp post, trees. Hanging above him from two ropes, a big wooden sign with hand lettering.
cena.animar: gold coins keep falling like rain all over the street, the stick figure man looks up, smiles and waves his raised hand, a coin bounces off his head.

blocos.fala: Imagina: cada segundo que passa, cai uma moeda no seu bolso. Dormindo, comendo, até no banho.

cena.prompt: A comic strip with three horizontal panels stacked vertically, all inside the top 62% of the image, with thick black panel borders and a plain paper area below them. Top panel: our character sleeping in bed at night while gold coins drop into a glass jar on the nightstand. Middle panel: our character eating a plate of rice and beans at a kitchen table while coins drop into his shirt pocket. Bottom panel: our character showering behind a curtain, smiling, with coins falling with the water.
cena.animar: in the top panel the man sleeps and breathes while coins drop into the jar; in the middle panel he chews his food while coins drop into his shirt pocket; in the bottom panel water and coins fall in the shower and he smiles. The three panels and their borders stay fixed.

blocos.fala: Pra juntar um milhão, você ia precisar de onze dias e meio. Sem parar.

cena.prompt: The top 38% of the image is a plain light wall (a panel will cover it). Below, between 40% and 62% of the height: our character celebrating with arms up next to a wall calendar with 11 days crossed out with a red marker and the 12th half crossed, and a big pile of money bags at his feet.
cena.animar: the stick figure man jumps and celebrates with his arms up, the money bags wobble a little. The calendar stays unchanged.

blocos.fala: Agora o bilhão. Você ia dormir, acordar e dormir de novo, por muito, muito mais tempo.

cena.prompt: A bedroom at night seen from the side: our character asleep in bed under a blanket, a big round clock on the wall with motion lines around its hands, a wall calendar with many pages flying off it through the air, the window showing the moon and stars. Calm, slightly sleepy mood.
cena.animar: the man sleeps and breathes slowly under the blanket, the clock hands spin fast, calendar pages keep flying off the wall calendar across the room.

blocos.fala: Um bilhão de segundos dá quase trinta e dois anos.

cena.prompt: The top 38% of the image is a plain sunset sky (a panel will cover it). Below, between 40% and 62% of the height: five versions of our character standing in a row on a long road, from left to right getting older: a young man, a man with a beard, a man with grey hair, an older man with glasses, an old man with white hair and a cane.
cena.animar: the five men stand on the road, breathe, blink and shift their weight a little; the old man leans on his cane; the sun sets slowly.

blocos.fala: Parecem vizinhos. Mas um é uma viagem de férias, e o outro é uma vida inteira.

cena.prompt: The image is split vertically into two halves by a hand-drawn line. Left half: our character relaxing in a beach chair under a striped umbrella, a short vacation, with a small wooden sign. Right half: a long winding road of life from a school to a house to a park bench, with our character at different ages along it, and a small wooden sign. At the top, a hand-lettered title over each half.
cena.animar: on the left the man relaxes on the beach chair and the sea waves move; on the right the small figures walk slowly along the winding road. The titles and the signs stay unchanged.

blocos.fala: Esse vídeo foi feito inteiro no Claude. Comenta palito que eu te mando a skill.

cena.depois: que eu te mando a skill
cena.prompt: Our character in the same cozy living room, standing in the lower part of the frame (feet at about 62% of the height), smiling and pointing up with one finger. The top 45% of the image is a plain light wall with nothing on it (text will go there).
cena.animar: the man smiles, blinks and points up, moving his pointing hand up and down a little. The top of the image stays empty.
